record.question: Consider the statement, "The Hydrograph is the response of a given catchment to a rainfall input. It consists of flow in all the three phases of runoff, viz, surface runoff, interflow and baseflow and embodies the integrated effects of a wide variety of catchment and rainfall parameters having complex interaction". Choose the correct statement(s) from the followings:
options: identical storms in two catchments produce different hydrographs
identical storm in two catchment produce identical hydrographs
two different storms in a given catchment produce identical hydrographs
